title: Tenma Saki — A Year's Worth Of Thanks〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone, again.
Try to keep in mind what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Based on how much time we have left, this is gonna be our final playthrough, right? So, we should have Miku and the others come listen!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! This is our last practice for the year, y'know? That means it's gonna be the year's final song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In other words, it's our chance to thank them for everything they did for us this past year!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
They have done a lot for us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It would be nice to cap off the year by showing just how much we appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's go get them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They all sound really excited now...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I mean, we should be.
We're playing together for the last time this year.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (On top of that, Miku and the others are watching.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We get to show them just how much we've improved and how much we appreciate what they did for us this past year.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That means I need to put on the best performance I can too...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! That was super duper cool!
How do I put it...? That totally rocked my heart!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it was the perfect way to cap off the year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. You weaved your individual sounds together so beautifully... It was a wonderful expression of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Through this performance, we wanted to show our appreciation for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're standing here today because of everything that you've all done for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A lot happened this past year...
But you've always been there to watch over us and cheer us on. So, thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. When you all put it that way, I can't help but feel moved...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm just glad that I was able to help a little...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We're looking forward to having another great year with all of you...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Likewise.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we're looking forward to seeing how you girls grow moving forward too.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That's it. Our final practice...
I'm kinda sad that we don't have another one until the fourth.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're sad...? We're only gonna be apart for a few days.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We won't be able to practice together for various reasons, but at least we'll be able to visit the shrine together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Our shrine visit!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
None of you are allowed to be late!
You have no idea how super duper excited I am about it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly, Saki, I'm more worried about you being late...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I won't be!
I do have a tendency to stay up late during New Year's, which puts me at risk for oversleeping...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Tsukasa promised to wake me up no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, you should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Oh, can't it just be the new year already...? They're gonna have so many fun stalls and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, they did have a bunch of different stalls set up last time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Including ones that served ice cream.
Saki was like a kid in a candy store.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
And she got the biggest one she could find.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-Because it looked so colorful and yummy...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it was so big that we had to help you finish it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. It was so cold...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I-I'm sorry, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we stick to warm things this year?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I got to spend time with the others like this again this year...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We had a lot of fun, but also had to deal with some tough stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But we made it through by sticking together...
Plus, we had Miku and the others watching over us the entire time.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So, I wanna keep doing my best next year... Together!)
